name: Erythropoietic Porphyria

criteria.description: Early-onset, non-blistering photosensitivity with painful erythema and edema
Markedly increased free protoporphyrin levels in erythrocytes
Identification of pathogenic mutations in the FECH gene
Evidence of hepatic dysfunction or cholestasis secondary to protoporphyrin accumulation
Lack of blister formation differentiating from other porphyrias

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of early-onset photosensitivity with elevated erythrocyte protoporphyrin and pathogenic FECH mutation
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is supported by biochemical and genetic testing; liver involvement may complicate disease course.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Non-blistering painful photosensitivity with erythema and edema
searchTerms: painful sun sensitivity with redness and swelling
red swollen painful skin after sun exposure
high levels of free protoporphyrin in blood

pathognomonic.symptomName: Immediate burning and stinging sensation on sun-exposed skin

common.symptomName: Chronic skin thickening and lichenification on sun-exposed areas
searchTerms: thickened, rough skin on sun areas

common.symptomName: Mild hepatobiliary dysfunction with elevated liver enzymes
searchTerms: mild liver problems with raised enzymes
anemia caused by red blood cell breakdown
blood loss due to red cell destruction
stones in gallbladder due to protoporphyrin
bile duct stones from pigment deposits
tiredness from ongoing red blood cell loss
yellowing of skin and eyes from liver issues

rare.symptomName: Neuropathic pain due to hepatic encephalopathy
searchTerms: nerve pain from liver brain dysfunction
neuropathic pain linked to liver encephalopathy
pain caused by liver-related nerve damage

laboratory: Markedly elevated free protoporphyrin in erythrocytes
Elevated liver transaminases in cases with hepatic involvement
imaging: Liver MRI may show fibrosis or cirrhosis in advanced cases
genetic: Pathogenic mutations in FECH gene (ferrochelatase deficiency)
other: Skin biopsy showing subepidermal edema without blister formation

distinguishingFeatures: Red urine due to uroporphyrin accumulation

redFlags: Severe photosensitivity with immediate pain and edema
